##### Project general facts

Oceanz by Danube is an iconic waterfront development in Dubai Maritime City, where contemporary architecture meets the elegance of branded luxury living. Comprising three striking towers, the project offers a collection of fully furnished studios, presidential suites, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as an exclusive selection of Oceanic Villas. Inspired by the design philosophy of Tonino Lamborghini Casa, Oceanz blends sophisticated interiors with breathtaking waterfront surroundings, creating a distinctive lifestyle defined by style, comfort, and refinement.

Residents enjoy an elevated resort-style lifestyle with an exceptional collection of amenities designed for relaxation, recreation, and everyday wellbeing. Many residences feature private swimming pools, while the waterfront setting creates an atmosphere of exclusivity and tranquility. Every aspect of the development is carefully curated to deliver an experience that combines the energy of Dubai with the serenity of coastal living, making Oceanz a landmark destination for those who appreciate contemporary luxury.

Inside, the residences showcase premium finishes and meticulously crafted branded interiors by Tonino Lamborghini Casa, reflecting a harmonious balance of modern elegance and bold Italian design. Fully equipped kitchens provide everyday functionality, while each home is delivered with designer furnishings that create a sophisticated, move-in-ready living environment. Spacious layouts, refined materials, and exceptional attention to detail complete residences that embody a new standard of luxury waterfront living.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Maritime City is a unique and innovative community located in the heart of Dubai. As a specialized maritime hub, it offers a comprehensive range of services, facilities, and infrastructure to support the maritime industry, making it a prominent destination for maritime-related activities.

Dubai Maritime City is designed to create a conducive environment for businesses and professionals in the maritime sector. The community features state-of-the-art shipyards, dry docks, and repair facilities, catering to the needs of shipbuilding, repair, and maintenance companies. It also offers specialized zones for maritime businesses, including maritime services, marine equipment providers, and maritime education and training institutions.

Dubai Maritime City is strategically located, offering convenient access to major transportation hubs and business districts. The community benefits from its proximity to Dubai's ports, connecting it to global trade routes and facilitating seamless movement of goods and services. Its strategic location ensures efficient logistics and easy connectivity for businesses and residents alike.
